title: S2-B4 remaining-factor scientific protocol freeze
decision: Freeze SW10_S2_B4_PROTOCOL_V1 prospectively before any B4 outcome inspection. Primary B4 family contains four new liquidity proxy tests and six new market-regime interaction tests across the six frozen horizons. Three constructable but algebraically duplicate proxies remain diagnostic-only; six unavailable components remain excluded. All B4 hypotheses are non-directional discovery hypotheses and cannot directly receive ADVANCE from this same panel; supported results may seed separately preregistered independent validation.
evidence: MWE-SW10-S2B4P-001 COMPLETE/VERIFIED; 10 CERTIFIED_PROXY and 6 UNAVAILABLE. Preflight established REL_MARKET_10 rank-equivalence to RET_MOM, LIQ_PRIOR20_ACTIVITY identity with VOL_TURN_V2_CAUSAL, and MARKET_SPY_VOL14 identity with existing VOL_REGIME semantics. No B4 scientific outcome was computed or inspected.
rationale: Preserves the outcome-blind B4 preflight semantics and avoids relabeling existing RET_MOM, VOL_TURN_V2_CAUSAL, or VOL_REGIME information as new evidence. Date-level market states are tested only as conditioners/interactions, not broadcast as independent cross-sectional rows. No unavailable source is manufactured or backfilled.

prohibited: treating diagnostic duplicates as independent evidence
using unavailable components without separate source certification and new prospective freeze
broadcasting date-level market states as independent cross-sectional observations
historical expected earnings dates treated as prospective
S3 transition before S2 exit criteria
metadata_json.support_rule: A horizon is discovery-supported only if BH q<=0.05, abs standardized effect>=0.20, an immediately adjacent prespecified horizon has the same sign, at least 3/4 temporal blocks have that sign, no block exceeds 50% of absolute aggregate effect, concentration/sign robustness passes, and semantic/data-integrity gates pass.

multiple_testing.family: 10 primary hypotheses x 6 horizons; diagnostic-only and unavailable components excluded

disposition_mapping.RETAIN_AS_WEAK_EVIDENCE: Valid/testable primary hypothesis fails exactly one of FDR or material-effect gates while passing semantic and robustness gates.
disposition_mapping.INVALID_SEMANTICS_NOT_TESTABLE: Semantic validity or required testability fails.
disposition_mapping.SEED_INDEPENDENT_VALIDATION_HYPOTHESIS: Non-directional primary hypothesis satisfies the full support rule; observed sign is frozen only as a hypothesis for a separate prospective validation and is not an ADVANCE decision.

market_interaction_design.model: cross-sectional OLS forward_return ~ intercept + primary_rank + market_state + primary_rank*market_state
market_interaction_design.market_state: raw causal date-level proxy; standardized prospectively using expanding/past-only history, no future information
market_interaction_design.primary_rank: same-date percentile rank with average ties mapped as 2*pct_rank-1
